item.title: Lost Lore reference (3.7.3)
item.description:
Version: 3.7.3
Author: Vinny
Category: Maps coordinates & compasses
Updated: 2026-04-25 00:28 UTC
Downloads: 102,051
File: LostLore_3.7.3.zip (110.9 KB)

Lost Lore reference provides an ingame list of locations to find lost lore pages and other hardtofind items like treasure chests and dwarf markers.

This plugin is supported by my Vinny Loader plugin.

Most zones have at least some Lost Lore collections.
More are being added with new updates.

Currently supported deeds:
Rare Treasures Rare Chests Dwarf Markers Explorer places
Flowers Ranger Caches Relics Flowers and other collections.

Limitations
Ever needed to get from one location around Middle Earth and youre not a hunter or cant bribe one to port you around? StableGuy gives you a quick and easy method of using the available Stable Masters to show you shortest path from A to B.

Simply select the starting location and where you want to go and StableGuy will show you the shortest route by calculating the minimum number of hops to travel from A to B thus minimising cost and travel time.

item.title: Compass (1.1)
item.description:
Version: 1.1
Author: Garan
Category: Maps coordinates & compasses
Updated: 2016-02-18 21:36 UTC
Downloads: 46,842
File: Compass ver 1.1.zip (35.3 KB)

This plugin simply displays your heading.

Due to limitations of the Lua API the compass does not automatically update as you move so you have to left click the display to refresh it.

The display is initially in the center of the screen and can be moved using the standard LotRO Ctrl feature.

There is a simple animation for the refresh displaying a compass with needle that can be disabled it gets annoying after a few times by right clicking on the display. You can also change the font and color by opening the Options window by right clicking on the display.
